body.message:
We need to rent five flats in the same building or as close to each other as possible. We are looking for a long-term tenancy, but with monthly payments. We are prepared to sign a long-term tenancy agreement and pay each month.

Could you please let us know if you can find a suitable option? If there aren’t five flats in the same building, we’d be open to considering several neighbouring buildings in the same area
